title: rolter · overview
description: Traffic, latency and errors across the gateway, the control plane and the dashboard. Imported by `just dogfood` (#956). Panels query signoz_traces directly rather than using the query builder, so they keep working when the builder's shape changes between SigNoz releases.

widgets.title: Requests per minute by service
widgets.description: Every span rolter emits, split by plane. rolter-ui is the dashboard's own browser tracing.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, serviceName, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND parentSpanID = '' GROUP BY ts, serviceName ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: p95 latency by service
widgets.description: Tail latency, not the mean — the mean hides exactly the requests worth looking at.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, serviceName, quantile(0.95)(durationNano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND parentSpanID = '' GROUP BY ts, serviceName ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Errored spans per minute
widgets.description: Anything the instrumentation marked as an error, by service.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, serviceName, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND (hasError = true OR statusCode >= 2) GROUP BY ts, serviceName ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Slowest operations (p95)
widgets.description: Where the time actually goes, by span name.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT serviceName, name AS operation, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.95)(durationNano) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms, round(max(durationNano) / 1e6, 1) AS max_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} GROUP BY serviceName, operation ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Gateway upstream calls
widgets.description: What the gateway sent to providers, and how long each took. Empty until a route is exercised.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT name AS operation, count() AS calls, countIf(hasError = true OR statusCode >= 2) AS errors, round(quantile(0.95)(durationNano) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_datetime}} AND timestamp <= {{.end_datetime}} AND serviceName = 'rolter-gateway' GROUP BY operation ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20
